PROC
PROC_UND_PanicRoom_HiddenGnomeLeave_Immediately()
AND
QRY_UND_PanicRoom_BarrelWithinReach(20.0)
AND
NOT DB_Defeated(S_GLO_HiddenGnome_6cacd488-c479-47a9-9a39-1cfb2bf6836e)
THEN
ToInventory(S_UND_Runepowder_Barrel_f09c0a57-6b72-4308-a588-322cb06d47f3, S_GLO_HiddenGnome_6cacd488-c479-47a9-9a39-1cfb2bf6836e);

QRY
QRY_CRIME_BlockRegisterCrime(_Character,_Crime,_,(CHARACTER)S_TUT_Lab_TrappedDevourer_6ca92237-eb1e-4ed8-a1ee-18b3bef21558,_)
AND
DB_CRIME_AssaultType(_,_,_Crime)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag(COL_Morgue_State_UsInColony_8e0a2351-4e88-0b3f-4088-6de33da0ddd4)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)COL_Morgue_State_UsFreed_ac8042af-6b62-4d54-ad2c-44cf7aaa107f)
AND
NOT DB_Dead((CHARACTER)S_COL_Butcher_82ebdca0-f478-4c2b-a529-179a7e82b3db)
AND
GetHitpoints(S_TUT_Lab_TrappedDevourer_6ca92237-eb1e-4ed8-a1ee-18b3bef21558,_Hitpoints)
AND
_Hitpoints > 0
AND
IsEnemy((CHARACTER)S_COL_Butcher_82ebdca0-f478-4c2b-a529-179a7e82b3db,S_TUT_Lab_TrappedDevourer_6ca92237-eb1e-4ed8-a1ee-18b3bef21558,0)
AND
CrimeGetNewID(_CrimeId)
THEN
DebugText(_Character,"|Attacked us.|");
PROC_COL_Morgue_AttackedUs((CHARACTER)_Character);
PROC_CharacterRegisterCrime((CHARACTER)_Character,"COL_Morgue_Us_Freed",S_COL_Morgue_Cage_Us_5f3613eb-f290-4828-80dc-167ed16134d4,S_COL_Butcher_82ebdca0-f478-4c2b-a529-179a7e82b3db,_CrimeId);

IF
DB_InRegion(_Player, (TRIGGER)S_SHA_LastJusticiation_UltimatumLureArea_56305d1e-25cf-443e-8299-00d7ed144d04)
AND
DB_PartyMembers(_Player)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)SHA_LastJusticiar_State_Hostile_ed6bc07d-6041-49c3-9fc5-bc604bc8543b)
AND
NOT QRY_CheckOtherPartyMembersInTrigger(_Player, (TRIGGER)S_SHA_LastJusticiation_UltimatumLureArea_56305d1e-25cf-443e-8299-00d7ed144d04)
AND
IsForceUpdate(S_SHA_LastJusticiar_UltimatumLure_4700da81-8c8e-455f-9158-dc2b6c204f29, 0)
THEN
SetForceUpdate(S_SHA_LastJusticiar_UltimatumLure_4700da81-8c8e-455f-9158-dc2b6c204f29, 1);

IF
AddedTo(S_TWN_BloodBankInventoryList_ccf165b7-1cf6-4111-a8a5-54526a50396d, (CHARACTER)_Player, _)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
IsInPartyWith(S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255, _Player, 1)
AND
GetDistanceTo(S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255, _Player, _Dist)
AND
_Dist < 8.0
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("TWN_BloodBankInventoryList")
THEN
PROC_TryStartAD((DIALOGRESOURCE)TWN_InteractedWithBloodBankInventoryList_PAD_c770e379-31e0-f7d0-45a2-2f541a240e52, S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255);

IF
DB_Defeated(_Character)
AND
DB_PartyMembers((CHARACTER)_Character)
AND
DB_LOW_DjinniTrapVictim(_Character)
THEN
NOT DB_LOW_DjinniTrapVictim(_Character);
TeleportTo(_Character,(ITEM)S_LOW_DjinniTrap_Lamp_41743414-bbea-4f42-8c2f-9c9fe3de1d1e,"LOW_DjinniTrapVictim_Out",0,0,0,1,1);

IF
UseFinished(_Player,S_LOW_GortashFamilyHome_GortashPortrait_5d8c20bc-1e8a-4637-bde2-fc1b5dbdf688,1)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
NOT DB_Is_InCombat(_Player,_)
AND
NOT DB_DialogName(LOW_GortashFamilyHome_PAD_GortashPortrait_d26ddb43-d9f6-6994-c2cb-4107fed7754a,_)
THEN
PROC_TryStartAD(LOW_GortashFamilyHome_PAD_GortashPortrait_d26ddb43-d9f6-6994-c2cb-4107fed7754a,_Player);
